title: Fix sending an empty String like "" causes an error #9429

timeline.message: Fix sending an empty String like "" causes an error #9429
timeline.author: Andrey Mizurov

timeline.body:
Motivation:

Handle https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc7692#section-7.2.3.6

Result:

The empty buffer is correctly handled in deflate  encoder/decoder. Fixes #9429 .
Can one of the admins verify this patch?

maybe we can inline this into the condition where it is used?

`if (readable && compositeDecompressedContent.numComponents() <= 0 && !EMPTY_DEFLATE_BLOCK.equals(msg.content())) {`
